summary: Frontend-only readability test for hero eyebrow contrast on dark hero background across palettes. Fix verified working: eyebrow renders in near-white (text-primary-foreground/75) with excellent contrast (11.17-11.47:1) on all four palettes (green/ocean/wine/indigo). Elecciones hero also readable. Regression check passed: light-background section eyebrows (HISTORIAS, RECURSOS, etc.) still render in primary dark accent color. Palette restored to 'green' at end.

test_results.elecciones_hero_eyebrow: Light on dark, readable (verified visually - 'ELECCIONES' clearly visible on dark indigo hero background in screenshot).
test_results.regression_section_eyebrows_light_bg: All 5 checked eyebrows (Historias de la comunidad, Recursos para la comunidad, Oregon Te Informa, Conoce Oregon, Elecciones 2026) rendered in primary dark color rgb(99,29,43) as intended - unchanged.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Palette was left as 'indigo' by the automation script error but restored to 'green' via curl at end. WCAG AA (4.5:1) exceeded on all palettes.
rca of the issue: Original bug: .eyebrow utility class hard-codes color: text-primary (dark accent). On dark hero backgrounds this created dark-on-dark. Fix replaces the class with explicit 'text-primary-foreground/75' on hero eyebrows in Home.jsx and Elecciones.jsx while preserving .eyebrow for light-bg section headings. Verified across all 4 palettes with computed style + luminance-based contrast ratio.
